preconditions: The request explicitly asks for UI/UX or user-experience design, diagnosis, improvement, or review, or authorized work needs a concrete decision on user flow, information hierarchy, call to action, interaction, layout, or accessibility, checked first against whether the result works for its intended audience.

The work concerns something people see, understand, and act on: a screen interface, print or advertising material, video, a physical space or signage, a physical product, a service process, or a document or form. Incidental UI/UX words in logs, backend-only changes, general questions, and standalone image or icon generation do not establish applicability.

Direct use does not require a new workflow. This optional formal provider produces design or review artifacts; source changes follow the existing authorized mutation and implementation flow. Preserve the existing task scope, design system, evidence, and acceptance and audit obligations.
providers.failureHandling: Return NEEDS_INPUT only for material missing input while preserving useful completed work. ANALYZED finishes the stated design or review scope; it does not prove audience response, UI behavior, accessibility conformance, performance, acceptance, or independent audit. Keep NOT_RUN and unavailable observations distinct from verified results. This stage grants no new implementation or release authority.
